title: Gallipoli seized
body: The Ottomans gain their first permanent European foothold on the Dardanelles.

title: Edirne becomes the European capital
body: Adrianople anchors Ottoman expansion into Thrace and the Balkans.

title: Battle of Kosovo
body: Serbian power is broken after a costly battle; Ottoman influence deepens in the central Balkans.

title: Battle of Nicopolis
body: A crusading army is defeated, confirming Ottoman control over Bulgaria.

title: Battle of Ankara & Collapse
body: Timur crushes Bayezid I. The first Anatolian unification fractures as old beyliks re-assert independence during the Ottoman Interregnum.

title: Skanderbeg Rebellion begins
body: Gjergj Kastrioti (Skanderbeg) seizes Krujë and defects, launching a 25-year war of liberation that opens a deep pocket in western Rumelia.

title: Varna
body: The crusade of Varna is destroyed on the Black Sea coast.

title: Constantinople falls
body: Mehmed II captures the Byzantine capital and turns Istanbul into the imperial center.

title: Battle of Otlukbeli
body: Mehmed II uses modern artillery to defeat Uzun Hasan, extending absolute hegemony deep into the eastern Anatolian highlands.

title: Crimea enters Ottoman orbit
body: Genoese Black Sea ports fall and the Crimean Khanate becomes an Ottoman vassal.

title: Battle of Vaslui
body: Stephen the Great crushes a much larger Ottoman army in Moldavia, delaying direct subjection.

title: Albania fully conquered
body: Following the fall of Shkodër and the Treaty of Constantinople, Venetian-held outposts are ceded, incorporating Albania completely into Rumelia.

title: Sack of Kyiv
body: Major Crimean victory; sack of the city.

title: Kilia and Akkerman taken
body: Moldavia loses its Black Sea outlets and accepts Ottoman suzerainty.

title: Political Unification of Anatolia
body: Following victory at Turnadağ, the last major independent Anatolian beylik is formally eliminated, bringing Asia Minor under total Ottoman administration.

title: Capture of Algiers
body: Ottoman foothold established in the Maghreb.

title: Invasion of Corsica
body: A joint Franco-Ottoman fleet and land force under admirals like Turgut Reis and Paulin de la Garde invaded Corsica, capturing Bastia, Saint-Florent, and Bonifacio from Genoa.

title: Belgrade falls
body: Suleiman opens the road into Hungary.

title: Great Crimean Raid
body: Major Crimean victory reaching the outskirts of Moscow.

title: Battle of Mohacs
body: The medieval Kingdom of Hungary collapses after a catastrophic defeat.

title: Capture of Peñón of Algiers
body: Spanish fortress taken by Hayreddin Barbarossa.

title: Capture of Tunis
body: Temporary Ottoman occupation of the city.

title: Conquest of Tunis
body: Spanish reconquest of Tunis.

title: Suleiman subdues Moldavia
body: Suleiman the Magnificent invades Moldavia, takes Suceava, deposes Petru Rareș, and annexes Bender/Tighina.

title: Budin Eyalet established
body: Central Hungary becomes directly administered Ottoman territory while Transylvania becomes a vassal buffer.

title: Capture of Tripoli
body: Tripoli annexed into the Ottoman Empire.

title: Temesvar Eyalet created
body: The Banat frontier is reorganized as a major Ottoman eyalet.

title: Szigetvar and Suleiman's death
body: Suleiman dies during the siege, marking the end of the classic expansion age.

title: Lepanto and Cyprus
body: Cyprus is conquered, but the Ottoman fleet is checked by the Holy League at Lepanto.

title: Burning of Moscow
body: Devlet I Giray burns Moscow, leading to massive enslavement.

title: Ottoman Reconquest of Tunis
body: Permanent annexation of Tunisia.

title: Battle near Moscow
body: Crimean invasion under Ğazı II Giray; Russian victory.

title: Long Turkish War
body: A long Habsburg-Ottoman conflict begins across Croatia, Hungary, and Transylvania.

title: Egri Eyalet organized
body: Eger's fall extends Ottoman administration into northern Hungary.

title: Kanije Eyalet organized
body: Nagykanizsa becomes the southwestern Ottoman Hungarian frontier center.

title: Khmelnytsky Uprising Alliance
body: Crimean Khanate allies with Bohdan Khmelnytsky against Poland.

title: Varat Eyalet created
body: Oradea becomes the capital of a new Partium frontier province.

title: Uyvar Eyalet created
body: Nove Zamky anchors a short-lived Ottoman province in Upper Hungary.

title: Candia falls
body: Crete is absorbed after one of early modern Europe's longest sieges.

title: Podolia annexed
body: The Ottoman Empire reaches its farthest northern European province.

title: First Siege of Chyhyryn
body: Ottoman defeat; Russians and Cossacks held the fortress.

title: Chyhyryn campaign
body: Ottoman victory; Kara Mustafa captured and destroyed Chyhyryn.

title: Chyhyryn Campaign
body: Kara Mustafa captures and destroys Chyhyryn.

title: Treaty of Bakhchisarai
body: Ottoman–Russian peace; confirmed control of southern Right-bank Ukraine.

title: Upper Hungary
body: Imre Thokoly receives Ottoman backing for a short-lived principality.

title: Second Siege of Vienna
body: The failed siege begins the strategic reversal of Ottoman power in central Europe.

title: Third Campaign of Tabriz
body: Ottomans again occupied Tabriz temporarily.

title: Nakhchivan Campaign
body: Ottoman devastation of Safavid territory leading to peace.

title: Treaty of Amasya
body: First formal Ottoman–Safavid peace; Iraq recognized as Ottoman.

title: Treaty of Constantinople (1590)
body: Greatest Ottoman territorial gains in the Caucasus.

title: Treaty of Nasuh Pasha
body: Borders restored largely to those of 1555; Ottomans lost Caucasian conquests.

title: Treaty of Serav
body: Confirmed Safavid gains with modified tribute arrangements.

title: Treaty of Zuhab
body: Established the long-term Ottoman–Persian frontier; Iraq remained Ottoman.

title: Uyvar and Upper Hungary lost
body: Habsburg counteroffensives begin dismantling Ottoman Hungary.

title: First Ottoman invasion of the Morea
body: Large-scale raid initiating Ottoman interest in the region.

title: Siege of the Hexamilion Wall
body: Ottoman forces under Murad II break through the defensive wall at the Isthmus of Corinth.

title: Conquest of northern Morea
body: Ottoman advance forces the Despotate of the Morea into tributary status.

title: Conquest of the Despotate of the Morea
body: Final annexation of the Peloponnese, ending the Despotate.

title: Long Turkish War
body: A protracted conflict between the Ottoman Empire and the Habsburg Monarchy, marked by stalemate and significant territorial shifts on the Hungarian frontier.
sultan: Murad III / Mehmed III / Ahmed I

title: Sack of Kyiv
body: Major Crimean victory.

title: Frontier raids
body: Series of Crimean successes.

title: Raid into Ryazan
body: Crimean success.

title: Raid on Muscovy
body: Crimean success.

title: Raid toward Ryazan
body: Crimean success.

title: Oka frontier raid
body: Crimean success.

title: Great Crimean Raid on Moscow
body: Major Crimean victory.

title: Failed relief of Kazan
body: Crimeans failed to relieve Kazan during Ivan IV's siege.

title: Battle of Sudbishchi
body: Russians defeated Crimean raiders.

title: Raids post-Astrakhan
body: Crimean raids following Russian conquest of Astrakhan.

title: Burning of Moscow
body: Led by Devlet I Giray; major victory with massive enslavement.

title: Battle near Moscow
body: Crimean invasion under Ğazı II Giray; Russian victory.

title: Time of Troubles raids
body: Series of slave-raiding expeditions (1605-1615).

title: Crimean-Cossack Alliance
body: Alliance with Bohdan Khmelnytsky; battles of Zhovti Vody, Korsuń, Pyliavtsi.

title: First Siege of Chyhyryn
body: Ottoman defeat; Russians and Cossacks held the fortress.

title: Chyhyryn campaign
body: Ottoman victory; Kara Mustafa captured and destroyed Chyhyryn.

title: Treaty of Bakhchisarai
body: Ottoman–Russian peace; confirmed Ottoman control of southern Right-bank Ukraine.
